info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Regulatory Authorities Registration API
info.description: The Regulatory Authorities Registration API allows organizations to register and manage their relationships with regulatory authorities within the banking sector. This endpoint facilitates the submission of necessary documentation and information required for compliance with industry regulations. It is particularly useful for banks and financial institutions looking to establish or update their engagement with various regulatory bodies. Users of this API can expect to streamline their compliance processes and improve interactions with regulatory authorities.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new regulatory authority in the corporate relations system. Ensure that you provide all required information in the request body, including regulatory details and contact information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit information regarding regulatory authorities within corporate relations. Ensure that all required fields are populated accurately to facilitate proper processing.
